scope: Yalnızca danışan ve diyetisyen ekranlarının arayüz yazı karakterleri. Logo, maskot ve karşılama dosyaları değiştirilmedi.
mobile:
Use case: precise-object-edit / typography-only UI image edit.
The supplied image is the EXACT EDIT TARGET: Limely's approved Turkish client dashboard. Make a STRICTLY TYPOGRAPHY-ONLY revision of this image.

ONLY permitted change: replace interface text lettering with a cleaner, slightly more refined contemporary sans-serif treatment: Manrope Semibold for headings, Inter Regular/Medium for body, labels and buttons, Inter Semibold for numbers. Headings should be less bubbly and less cartoonishly rounded than the current Fredoka-like lettering, but retain a friendly tone. This is a restrained font adjustment, not a redesign. Keep approximate existing font sizes, line breaks and visual hierarchy; no giant boldness. Headline "Günaydın, Elif" becomes a modern Manrope-like semibold shape. Numbers use straight clean contemporary sans-serif forms. Text color remains IDENTICAL.

CRITICAL LOCKED AREAS: The green lime logo is an image asset, not editable text. Preserve it exactly. Any brand wordmark spelling Limely/limely stays in its existing brand lettering. Preserve the avatar circle, the original lime/forest/ivory palette, every shape, every pixel-aligned card position and dimensions, corner radii, shadows, background texture, seven day pills, calendar selected state, circle chart arc and thickness, all eight water glasses and fill levels, the minus symbol, plus symbol and all outline icons, video icon, completion tick, navigation icons and selected tab backgrounds. Do not redraw, recolor, resize, shift, add or remove any non-text visual element. Keep full portrait composition, same aspect ratio and exact crop. No phone frame, caption, explanation, watermark, new brand elements or new section.

Retain ALL content and values, without paraphrasing or correcting: "Limely · danışan", "Elif Yılmaz", avatar "EY"; "Günaydın, Elif"; "1 / 6 öğün tamam"; weekdays "Pzt" 23, "Sal" 24 selected, "Çar" 25, "Per" 26, "Cum" 27, "Cmt" 28, "Paz" 29; calorie number 425, "/ 1.495 kcal"; "Planlanan öğünleri işaretledikçe dolar."; "Su", "3 / 8", "Bardak"; "Sonraki görüşme", "27 Kasım Cuma, 18:30", "Online"; "Planım"; "08:00", "Kahvaltı", "425 kcal", "Yulaf ezmesi" and visible portion line. Bottom "Bugün", "Ölçüm", "Mesaj", "Randevu", "Liste".
Anchor each new text run to its original location. Keep the original bounding boxes and same line breaks. No alteration outside letter and numeral glyphs. The output must look like the very same approved screen with only a modest interface font change.
